description: Pipeline for the single NAV-% policy. LIVE runtime uses the Agentic Robinhood account as the source of truth for NAV/cash/positions/HWM/dashboard/Risk Gate. PAPER book remains for tests/dev. Candidate Discovery, Deep Research, Investment Thesis, Portfolio Decision, Position Monitoring, paper Execution Controller (OrderPlan), paper fill + blotter, Human Approval Packet, and Robinhood review-only are implemented. Stops after robinhood_order_review. review_equity_order is informational/preflight only. No place/cancel. No capital transfers.

live_ai.notes: AI Gateway is the only module that may call OpenAI/Anthropic. Structured outputs only. LIVE AI may research and propose. It must not place or cancel.

stages.notes: Surfaces research candidates only. Does not buy. Does not create ACTIVE sleeve assignments. Same-sector/sleeve crowding uses OVERLAP_PRIORITY_PENALTY / DEFERRED_DUE_TO_RESEARCH_QUEUE_OVERLAP, not a max-N reject. Path is Candidate → ResearchReport → InvestmentThesis → PortfolioDecision → ProposedAction → RiskGate. Production AI screening/research goes through the AI Gateway (config/ai.json) with a $10/month hard cap. LIVE AI may create proposals only; LIVE_ORDER_PLACEMENT remains false.

Deep Research produces a ResearchReport before any thesis. Python collects facts and derived metrics. AI interprets. Path is Candidate → ResearchReport → InvestmentThesis → PortfolioDecision → ProposedAction → RiskGate. A favorable report is not a trade.
Persisted sleeve + thesis. Not candidate discovery. No silent sleeve changes.
AI forms a DRAFT InvestmentThesis from a ResearchReport. Status stays DRAFT until a future real execution. No broker stop orders.

LIVE mode refreshes NAV/cash/buying power/positions from the Agentic Robinhood account, persists state/live_book, and feeds dashboard, family NAV, HWM, daily P/L, monitoring, and Risk Gate. PAPER mode keeps the isolated paper book for tests/dev. LIVE never falls back to paper $10,000 NAV. Live placement remains disabled.
Portfolio-level AI call compares researched names vs cash and SPY. NO_ACTION is valid. Python converts a valid decision into ProposedAction and sends it to the existing Risk Gate.

Paper Execution Controller. Converts a Risk-Gate-approved ProposedAction into an OrderPlan. BUY/ADD/REDUCE/SELL only. HOLD/WATCH/REJECT/NO_ACTION create no plan. Status remains PAPER_ONLY / BLOCKED_FROM_LIVE. Does not invent stop orders. Does not call review/place/cancel.

Paper fill + blotter reconciliation. Simulates fills for PAPER_ONLY OrderPlans against an isolated paper book. Deterministic market fill at eligible quote/reference price. Updates paper cash/quantity/average cost/P&L/NAV. Does not call review/place/cancel. Does not move money. Does not modify live thesis/account state.

Human Approval Packet. Packages a Risk-Gate-approved paper OrderPlan for a human to accept or reject. APPROVED does not place or cancel a live order. Packets expire or are superseded when quotes/thesis/research go stale, the book or risk state changes, or a newer decision replaces them.

Review-only bridge. Takes a still-valid APPROVED ApprovalPacket, revalidates quote/portfolio/thesis/risk, re-checks Risk Gate, and calls review_equity_order. Persists ReviewResult. REVIEW_ACCEPTED does not execute. Does not call place or cancel. Current terminal stage.

Evaluates existing positions. Python detects facts/triggers and persists state. AI reassesses the thesis. Meaningful triggers reuse Research refresh, Portfolio Decision, and Risk Gate. HOLD/ADD/REDUCE/SELL/NO_ACTION. Exit conditions are not broker stop orders. No execution tools.
